identity.title: Qualify SourceQualityReport malformed and edge fixtures

origin.kind: owner continuation request and canonical backlog selection
origin.summary: The owner authorized continued work after PL-0039; M-09 is the smallest dependency-ready backlog item and requires deterministic finite, missing, and topology edge fixtures.

state.current_summary: M-09 remains resolved; the final focused-build setup retry is now explicitly recorded without changing any acceptance outcome.

objective.summary: Close M-09 with a deterministic SourceQualityReport malformed and edge-case fixture suite using the existing Runner verifier and command path.
constraints: Reuse SourceQualityReportVerification and the existing --verify-source-quality-report command; do not create another verifier architecture or production validation abstraction.
Cover finite/missing semantics and malformed C3D topology at the owning load/analyze boundary with exact expected exception types.
Write generated fixtures and reports only under the supplied D-backed report directory and delete fixture files after the verifier finishes.
Do not change product behavior, SourceQualityReport schema, UI, recipe execution, version, R0 package, or release state.

criteria.text: The existing Runner verifier covers finite negative/positive values, zero/non-finite missing semantics, all-missing output, and deterministic statistics/ratios/mask/distribution evidence.
Malformed C3D fixtures deterministically reject incomplete headers, non-positive dimensions, mismatched declared lengths, and overflowing grid dimensions before SourceQualityReport creation.

The fixture suite uses the existing --verify-source-quality-report command, produces its report and JSON under the D-backed evidence root, cleans transient fixture files, and changes no production behavior or schema.
Hosted CI invokes the existing SourceQualityReport verifier after build and rejects a non-passing or incomplete case matrix without altering other verifier commands.
Focused Release verification, standard dotnet test facade, full Release build, NuGet health, structure, Vision SDK package boundary, issue validation, documentation links, and diff hygiene pass.

context.summary: Existing 13-case report verifier and report writer.

evidence.observation: The current Runner verifier passed 18/18. Its report records signed finite statistics, existing zero/non-finite and all-missing semantics, and exact rejection cases for incomplete headers, non-positive dimensions, declared-length mismatch, and grid-dimension overflow.

The suite reuses --verify-source-quality-report, writes report/JSON and generated malformed fixtures beside the D-backed report, deletes every fixture in finally, and left zero C3D files in the evidence root. The scoped diff changes only verifier, CI, documentation, and ledger surfaces; no production contract or schema changed.

The hosted workflow runs the existing SourceQualityReport Runner command after build and throws on either a nonzero exit or absence of the exact 18/18 complete-report marker; existing verifier commands remain in place.

Current-tree checks passed: focused and full Release builds with zero warnings/errors across 15 projects, SourceQualityReport 18/18, standard facade 2/2, NuGet vulnerable/deprecated findings 0/0, structure 68/68, fixed Vision SDK package identity/checksum, documentation targets present, issue validation, and diff hygiene.

A first final focused --no-restore build against a newly introduced empty artifacts path failed with NETSDK1004 because project.assets.json was absent. After an explicit restore into that same D-backed path, the focused Release build passed with zero warnings and zero errors; focused-final-restore.log preserves the prerequisite recovery.

events.summary: Resolved after all five acceptance criteria received current evidence.
